description.en: Pre-submission checklist for DeepSeek Harness: manuscript structure and declaration statements, keyword-based coverage of starter CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA items, and a submission-pack scan with JSON/Markdown reports.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的投稿前清单：稿件结构与声明、对 CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA 起始条目的关键词覆盖，以及投稿材料包扫描，输出 JSON/Markdown 报告。
